state.note: Self-configuring embeds & privacy: location is approximate and uses GeoJS, with ipinfo.io as fallback. Place/postcode searches go to Nominatim and, for matching Canadian-style prefixes, Zippopotam. Builder reverse lookups send coordinates to BigDataCloud; the widget also requests prayer, weather, radar and font resources. Saved settings stay in your browser, which does not prevent these service requests. Precise location is optional and requires browser/host permission. An iframe host, including TablissNG, can strip allow="geolocation"; coarse/manual setup remain available. Storage policies can limit persistence. Request details.
